profile.headline: Senior Software Developer - Full Stack
profile.summary:
I am a experienced software developer with 10 years of experience implementing full-stack solutions in Java and c#; developed over 100 projects of all sizes, having more than 10 active projects, and platforms that handles more than 100,000 request per month. 

Constantly consulted by 3 country-big companies in the healthcare and insurance industries. Finishing projects with an average of 3 weeks ahead of schedule. Assessed a wide range of technologies, including Kafka, Java, Java - Spring .NET, JavaScript, Node.js, C#, Angular HTML, CSS, and CMS platforms such as Drupal and WordPress to drive exceptional results.

Contact me via my personal webpage https://santi.unclick.com.co

positions.title: Principal Software Developer & Project Manager
positions.description:
Senior Software Developer
•	Led development of key projects and administered technical leadership over 3 main core systems.
•	Maintained 24/7 and rapid support of all operable software programs.
•	Transformed from local to cloud service legacy software for remote work in pandemics in less than 1 week.
•	Ensured integration of Web Services with other web packages creating 40% less paperless work.
•	Generated new business and strengthened team through effective team contributions through effective leading, making solid teams with nearly 100% retention.
Technologies: C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Angular, Java Spring
positions.insights: ASP.NET MVC, Interpersonal Communication and +33 skills

positions.title: Software Developer Full Stack
positions.description:
Software development company for enterprise companies.

Software Developer
•	Spearheaded company operations as a senior founder and drove the development of multiple projects as the lead developer for over 10 years.
•	Authored end-to-end software development for more than 30 projects based on specifications using Java Spring for microservices and .net Core.
•	Led development of more than 70 projects with more than 10 currently active.
•	Engineered troubleshooting, debugging, and upgrading of more than 10 existing software.
•	Performed tests to deploy programs and systems in 50+ projects.
•	Coded more than 15 big size coupling projects with 3rd party programs using REST/SOAP Services.
Technologies: C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, WebServices, SQL Server, Angular, Azure Devops, Rest - Soap
positions.insights: ASP.NET MVC, Interpersonal Communication and +32 skills
